tonight.headline: As set you project 91.8; the projection lineup is 118.1
body: Week 5 is won, 195.3 to 132.76, and you are 1-4. Week 6 is Bok-aneers (4-1), projected 79.2.

Three of your starters are on bye — Jefferson, Gordon and the Vikings' defence — and they sit in your lineup at 0.0. That is 26.3 points of projection left on the table plus a defence. Three moves fix it, all below; the claim has to be in before 01:00 Wednesday.

case.label: Why 59% is soft
case.body: ESPN's win probability is computed on the lineup as set, with three zeros in it. With Coker, McLaurin and a defence in, you project roughly 126 against 79.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Coker inactive on Sunday (fallback Kamara, 10.1) or the claim lost to the one team ahead of you, Panda Attack. The Chiefs are the second claim.

doFirst.title: Claim the Ravens' defence; drop the Vikings'
doFirst.subtitle: Minnesota are on bye and you carry no other defence. Put in the Chiefs as a second claim with the same drop.

case.label: The hole
case.body: Vikings D/ST is your only defence and Minnesota are off in Week 6: 0.0 in the lineup.

case.label: The pick
case.body: Ravens 8.2, Chiefs 8.1 in this league's projection — a coin flip, so the projection decides: Baltimore first. Both rank top three this week (DraftSharks, RotoWire); Cleveland's Deshaun Watson was sacked eight times last week (Cleveland19, 11 Oct). Kansas City face a Chargers line missing Alt and Slater with the week's lowest implied total, 17.0 (RotoWire).

case.label: The drop
case.body: The Vikings are 87% rostered, so this disagrees with the market on the record: a defence on bye scores nothing, defences are streamed by policy, and dropping a skill player for a one-week defence would cost more. You are second in the order; only Panda Attack is ahead.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The Ravens score less in Week 6 than the Chiefs or the Patriots (archive) — the two you could have had instead.

doFirst.title: Start Coker in Jefferson's WR slot
doFirst.subtitle: Jefferson is on bye. Coker is questionable with a quad but 'on track'; Kamara is the fallback at 09:30 Sunday.

case.label: The slot
case.body: Jefferson projects 0.0 on bye. Coker 13.9 is the projection lineup's choice.

case.label: The doubt
case.body: Canales said Monday he is on track but has 'a couple of big days of practice ahead' (Joe Person, 12 Oct). Wednesday's report is the first evidence.

case.label: If he sits
case.body: McLaurin slides to WR and Kamara takes the flex. Both play at or after 11:00, so the swap is open at 09:30.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Coker plays and Kamara outscores him (archive).

doFirst.title: Start McLaurin in the flex for Gordon
doFirst.subtitle: Miami are on bye. McLaurin played through the hamstring and Daniels is back.

case.label: The slot
case.body: Gordon 0.0 on bye; McLaurin 12.4 is the projection lineup's flex.

case.label: The player
case.body: Four of four for 62 last week on the hamstring; Diggs has no timeline and Jayden Daniels returned from the elbow (RotoWire, 11 Oct).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Kamara or Marks, whoever is the best eligible alternative on Sunday, outscores McLaurin (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: Three byes are still in your lineup
whatWentWrong.lead: Jefferson, Gordon and the Vikings' defence are set to start at 0.0.

case.label: The cost
case.body: As set 91.8, projection lineup 118.1: a 26.3 gap before the defence. Last week's lineup scored 195.3, 0.6 short of the best available; this week it is wrong only because the week rolled.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing: the three cards above close it. If the claim fails, the Chiefs are the second claim and the Patriots (7.6) a free agent after Wednesday.

whatWentWrong.title: Kamara is losing the Saints' backfield
whatWentWrong.lead: Five touches in Week 5; Kendre Miller had 10 carries and is called the early-down back.

case.label: Why it matters now
case.body: He is Coker's fallback at 10.1. CBS tied the split to his back injury; no coach has said so.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Kamara out-touching Miller with a clean injury report. Until then he is a fallback, not a starter.
